top.line: A business that sets up small agentic teams for companies, with a control centre to see and stop them.
top.para: PrompTugal first; Agent Behaviour Policies on steroids; £500 to £20,000 by size.

in-short.line: The business, why now, the control centre, the first customer, ABPs, and the packages.

business.line: Few people know how to set up an agentic team; it took me months.
business.para: Three months ago I would have bought it.

control.line: Customers must see their agents and start and stop them: the product is control of execution.
control.para: Command and control is my next memo.

promptugal.line: PrompTugal.news needs a network of teams: editor, regions, city desks, journalists, agencies.
promptugal.para: Each a different size, on Claude, Codex, Cloudflare or a full workflow.

abp.line: Every Agent Behaviour Policy needs a policy agent and a couple of helpers.
abp.para: The same offering, focused on controlling agents.

pieces.line: Small open pieces: our workflow, Ruflo, sgit vaults, no databases, a choice of runtimes.

packages.line: £500 one agent, £1,500 a few sessions, £5,000 a team, £20,000 a network.
packages.para: Every size with the control centre.

name.line: What to call it: candidates, not a choice.
name.para: An outfitter, a foundry, agent crews.

limits.line: A first proposal, an illustration, and candidate names.

sources.line: My own thinking and earlier articles.
